hook_entry="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/dispatch.sh"; if [ ! -x "$hook_entry" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"git-discipline PostToolUse hook entry is unavailable."}'; exit 0; fi; "$hook_entry"
